'''Sithologists''' were a type of researcher that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The Sithologists were unaware that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]] were nephews of the Sith Lord [[Chagras]].
